tankmate.notes: Updates now download and install right inside the app — tap Update, then tap Install when Android asks. The first time, Android will ask you to allow TankMate to install its own updates; the app explains it in plain words and walks you through it. Your tanks and settings carry over.

batterybuddy.notes: Updates now download and install right inside the app — tap Update, then tap Install when Android asks. The first time, Android will ask you to allow Voltkeep Buddy to install its own updates; the app explains it in plain words and walks you through it. Your saved banks carry over.

solarbuddy.notes: Updates now download and install right inside the app — tap Update, then tap Install when Android asks. The first time, Android will ask you to allow BuddyRay to install its own updates; the app explains it in plain words and walks you through it. Your setups carry over.

buddyboard.notes: Buddy Board gains the Water Pressure High and Water Pressure Low alarms, each with its own silent switch, and its water gauge now says “not set up” for a tank that hasn't been taught yet. Your board settings carry over.

offgridbuddy.notes: The dash now says “not set up” for a water tank that hasn't been taught yet instead of guessing at a level, and two new alarms — Water Pressure High and Water Pressure Low — join the alarm list, each with its own silent switch. Your dash choices carry over.

waterbuddy.notes: Teach Water Buddy your tank — measure it, pick a common size, or show it the tank empty and full — so the level gauge reads right. Water Buddy now also watches line pressure and warns you if it runs too high or too low. Your tanks and settings carry over.
